description: Commands and environment variables that can escape or bypass the permission model. Privilege escalation (sudo, su, ssh), namespace and process bypass (unshare, nsenter, env, nohup, nice), wrapper bypass (exec, builtin), command-name redirection (alias), multi-tool dispatch (busybox), out-of-session persistence (crontab, at, setsid), and environment variables that hijack later command execution (BASH_ENV, LD_PRELOAD, etc.). Denied outright since the hook cannot scope them safely. Suspicious-but-useful variables like PATH and EDITOR soft-ask so the user can confirm legitimate per-call uses.

Commands.env:*: wrapper that can launch arbitrary commands
Commands.busybox:*: multi-tool dispatch — applet name hides what runs
Commands.nohup:*: detaches from session, escapes hook lifecycle
Commands.setsid:*: detaches from session, escapes hook lifecycle
Commands.nice:*: wrapper that can launch arbitrary commands
Commands.unshare:*: namespace bypass — runs in a fresh namespace
Commands.exec:*: replaces the shell, bypasses subsequent hooks
Commands.builtin:*: shell builtin invocation can mask redefined commands

EnvVars.GIT_SSH_COMMAND: git runs this on every remote operation
EnvVars.GIT_SSH: git runs this on every remote operation
EnvVars.GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF: git runs this on every diff
EnvVars.TAR_OPTIONS: injects flags into every tar invocation
EnvVars.LD_AUDIT: audit hook injected into dynamic exec
EnvVars.LESSOPEN: runs on file open in less
EnvVars.LESSCLOSE: runs on file close in less

EnvVars.EDITOR: executed by tools that open an editor
EnvVars.VISUAL: executed by tools that open an editor
EnvVars.GIT_PAGER: executed by git when paging output
EnvVars.GIT_EDITOR: executed by git when opening an editor
EnvVars.GH_HOST: redirects gh to a different GitHub host
